text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"\"we should perform community service because\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to produce a clear, grammatical main clause that is easy to follow."},{"evidence":"\"for examples i can give are\"","quality":"organization","description":"This captures the use of a recognizable explanation structure with an introduced list of supporting examples."},{"evidence":"\"help janitors... help the teachers... go to the library... to the hospitals\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"This captures the ability to develop an idea with multiple relevant examples rather than repeating the same point."},{"evidence":"\"clean and organize it so i could look perfect when kids come\"","quality":"lexical variety","description":"This captures the use of a somewhat broader range of content words to express the argument."},{"evidence":"\"we are helping our society to become much cleaner\"","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures the ability to maintain a consistent central idea across the response."}]}
